claim_scope: train-only correction-branch pilot conditional on a fixed previously trained parent; not validation or test_id evidence
hypothesis: For the first 64 temporal-frequency bins, adding true-velocity contrast/interface features and separate Eikonal-aligned phase and unphased scattering residual heads will strictly reduce four-seed mean full-401 train-confirmation relative L2 versus the frozen parent.

mechanism.phase_head: complex residual multiplied by the existing source-to-grid Eikonal carrier
mechanism.scatter_head: complex residual added without the direct-arrival carrier so reflected/scattered phase is not constrained to the direct path
mechanism.initialization: both output heads exactly zero, reproducing the parent before training
mechanism.target: first 64 orthonormal rFFT bins of the original train wavefield, not the sigma2 background wavefield

primary_metric: four-seed mean 34-record fresh train-confirmation full-401 relative L2, including the unchanged truth energy in bins 64-200
secondary_metrics: per-family candidate and parent relative L2
phase and scatter correction energy ratios
failure_signal: Reject before full-pool training if four-seed confirmation mean does not strictly improve, any lane fails, any output is non-finite, or the free-surface value is nonzero.
rollback: Additive pilot. Preserve the parent and all A3, B2-H, Helmholtz, ASAM, CPADC, WFP checkpoints. Stop this route before full-pool training if the cheap gate fails.
